replication: one independent chromosome per seed; paired settings reuse histories/streams; no genomic windows pooled
interval: window bands are observed min-max across three chromosomes, not CIs; selected positions use exact binomial/Bonferroni intervals
statistical_limit: three chromosomes are descriptive, not sufficient for tight marginal equivalence tests
phase8: deferred while 30-taxon MSRC scalability and matched-theory validation remain unresolved
